title: Machine and Echo
author: Isandro Ashgrove
blurb: Kestrel Galloway, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
